description: Partial original practice summaries. Related references are not equivalence or compliance claims. Applicability requires project review.

controls.title: Define the security checks a change needs
expectedEvidence: Reviewed project criteria and the check definitions that implement them

controls.title: Retain evidence for security decisions
expectedEvidence: A scoped review record linked to its actual execution artifacts

controls.title: Test security behavior and record findings
expectedEvidence: Results for authorized scoped tests, including denied and legitimate behavior

controls.title: Explain the mechanism behind a discovered vulnerability
expectedEvidence: Finding with root-cause analysis and linked correction

controls.title: Look for recurring causes across findings
expectedEvidence: Review of related findings and the resulting prevention work

controls.title: Turn supported lessons into tested workflow improvements
expectedEvidence: Reviewed prevention change, regression scenario, and release record

controls.title: Assess operating-system command construction
expectedEvidence: Reviewed command entry points and tests of untrusted input, or a scoped explanation requiring human assessment
